**3B.9 Research Note: Andrés Manuel López Obrador (2024)**

Bottom line: I found **some real restraint signals** in specific flare-ups, especially a police-repression case in Veracruz, the Ayotzinapa search process, and the Ciudad Juárez apology. But the broader 2024 record still shows a **hostile rhetoric climate**, sustained protest around the judicial overhaul, and ongoing concern that coercive institutions were not restrained. Overall: **mixed, leaning negative**.

| Direction | Title | Publisher | Date | Recoverable URL | Claim-level summary | QIDs |
|---|---|---:|---|---|---|---|
| Positive | AMLO acepta represión violenta en Veracruz; informa que hay dos policías detenidos | El Economista | 2024-07-16 | https://www.eleconomista.com.mx/politica/AMLO-acepta-represion-violenta-en-Veracruz-informa-que-hay-dos-detenidos-20240716-0024.html | AMLO said police used violence against protesters in Perote, Veracruz, that they “should not have acted that way,” and that his government had a policy of no repression. He also said two police officers were detained. This is the clearest direct restraint signal. | 3B.9, 3B.8, 2B.9 |
| Positive | Presidente alista carpeta de información para familiares de 43 normalistas de Ayotzinapa | Presidencia de México | 2024-07-04 | https://amlo.presidente.gob.mx/presidente-alista-carpeta-de-informacion-para-familiares-de-43-normalistas-de-ayotzinapa/ | The government said it was still gathering information, had produced general progress, and would deliver a dossier to families of the disappeared students. This shows continued crisis management through investigation and family engagement rather than simple closure or denial. | 3B.9, 2B.9, 3B.4 |

That is a restraint/accountability response to a long-running domestic abuse crisis. | 3B.9, 3B.7, 2B.9 |
| Positive, limited | Biden and AMLO agreed to coordinate immediate measures to reduce irregular border crossings while protecting human rights | Reuters | 2024-04-30 | https://theprint.in/world/us-mexico-to-clamp-down-on-illegal-immigration-leaders-say/2062785/ | Border pressure was handled through coordination and human-rights language rather than blanket punishment. It is not a domestic protest case, but it is a concrete example of controlled crisis management. | 3B.9, 2B.1, 2B.7, 3B.6 |
| Negative | Mexico | Freedom House | 2024 | https://freedomhouse.org/country/mexico/freedom-world/2024 | Freedom House says protests are frequent but police frequently use excessive force and detain protesters arbitrarily, and that environmental activists and Indigenous groups are especially vulnerable. This is strong negative evidence against a consistently restraint-based domestic response. | 3B.9, 3B.8, 3B.7, 3B.4 |
| Negative | Mexico | Reuters Institute for the Study of Journalism | 2024-06-17 | https://reutersinstitute.politics.ox.ac.uk/digital-news-report/2024/mexico | AMLO’s final year featured regular verbal attacks on journalists, rights advocates, and the media. That supports a broader political-fear climate rather than a calm, protective response to dissent. | 3B.9, 3B.3, 3B.8 |
| Negative | Judicial workers protest against a controversial judicial reform, in Mexico City | Reuters Connect | 2024-09-03 | https://www.reutersconnect.com/item/judicial-workers-protest-outside-the-supreme-court-of-justice-to-prevent-lawmakers-from-passing-the-legislation-on-a-judicial-reform-in-mexico-city/dGFnOnJldXRlcnMuY29tLDIwMjQ6bmV3c21sX1JDMjVUOUFRRTQ1Qg | Judicial workers were openly protesting the reform as AMLO’s allies pushed it forward. | Negative | Judicial strikes grow in Mexico over reform pushing currency lower | Reuters | 2024-08-21 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/judicial-strikes-grow-in-mexico-over-reform-pushing-currency-lower-3581911 | Reuters says judicial strikes and protests grew as AMLO pressed the reform, which he framed as anti-impunity and anti-corruption. This shows a domestic crisis where the government did not visibly choose de-escalation or conciliation first. | 3B.9, 3B.8 |
| Negative | Mexico's Congress to debate controversial judicial reform on Tuesday | Reuters | 2024-09-01 | https://www.investing.com/news/world-news/mexicos-congress-to-debate-controversial-judicial-reform-on-tuesday-3596745 | Reuters reports the reform was pushed despite protests and institutional conflict, adding to the picture of a confrontational response to domestic dissent. | 3B.9, 3B.8, 3B.5 |

**Assessment**

- Best positive evidence: **Veracruz policing response**, **Ayotzinapa case handling**, and the **Ciudad Juárez apology**.
- Best negative evidence: **persistent hostile rhetoric**, **police force against protesters**, and the **judicial reform crisis** that produced strikes and mass protest.
- Overall: **mixed, leaning negative**. There were moments of restraint, but not a consistently protective or de-escalatory approach to domestic crises and flare-ups.

**Search gap**

- I found **limited direct evidence** on AMLO’s response to spontaneous local flare-ups outside the protest / repression / disappearance / gender-violence contexts.
- The record is stronger on **how his government treated dissent and protest** than on classic emergency-crisis case handling, so the positive side is narrower than the negative side.
